newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH DIRECTOR STARTS FILMING PLAY BY POPE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH DIRECTOR STARTS FILMING PLAY BY POPE.

text.p: Polish director Krzysztof Zanussi has begun filming a play by Karol Wojtyla -- now Pope John Paul II -- entitled "Our God's Brother," PAP news agency reported on Monday.
It concerns the life of monk Albert Chmielowski, a painter and founder of a shelter for the homeless, and stars actor Scott Wilson with a Polish cast, the agency said.

The co-production between Polish company Tor and Italy's Trans-World-Film is being filmed in the Polish cities of Warsaw and Krakow and is due to be completed by the time of the Pope's planned visit to his native country in May next year.
The Polish-born pontiff as a young man had a passionate love of the theatre and went on to write poetry and plays.
